title: sideroxylon reclinatum subsp. austrofloridense

It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may help in protecting against various diseases and infections. The bioactive constituents of Sideroxylon reclinatum subsp. austrofloridense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
